code:
SELECT CloseMonth,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Type = 'New'
       THEN Amount END) AS New,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Type = 'Existing'
       THEN Amount END) AS Existing
FROM ... GROUP BY CloseMonth
